Messages.Author: IDEA
Messages.Body:
In the original jyhad rulebook, you were allowed to discard one card
at the end of your turn. In the VTES rulebook it says upto two. Is
this an errata or can we now double our discard potential?

Messages.Author: Spiridonas
Messages.Body:
Mr. Discard Question,
As stated on page 38 of the VtES rule book:

Influence phase and discarding:
"These are handled in the same way in both versions of the game, save for
the fact that in the Advanced Rules (I assume EVERYONE plays by these
rules) you
may only discard ONE card during your discard phase."
I hope this answers your question.

Mike C.
Spiridonas
Prince of Athens

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


It applies only to the Basic game. The rulebook (in the advanced
section) goes on to say:

Influence Phase and Discarding: These are handled the same way in both
versions of the game, save for the fact that in the Advanced Rules, you may
only discard one card during your discard phase.
